questions.subject: stanley_park
questions.q_en: Stanley Park opened in which year?
questions.q_zh: 斯坦利公园是哪一年开放的？
questions.explain_en: It opened in 1888, two years after Vancouver became a city.
questions.explain_zh: 1888 年开放，比温哥华建市晚两年。

questions.subject: stanley_park
questions.q_en: Stanley Park is named after Lord Stanley. What else is named after him?
questions.q_zh: 斯坦利公园以斯坦利勋爵命名，还有什么也以他命名？
questions.explain_en: He also donated hockey's Stanley Cup.
questions.explain_zh: 他还捐出了冰球的斯坦利杯。

questions.subject: stanley_park
questions.q_en: Stanley Park (about 400 ha) compared with New York's Central Park (about 341 ha) is…
questions.q_zh: 斯坦利公园约 400 公顷，纽约中央公园约 341 公顷，斯坦利公园……
questions.explain_en: 400 ha is more than 341 ha.
questions.explain_zh: 400 公顷比 341 公顷大。

questions.subject: stanley_park
questions.q_en: Stanley Park is on the land of which peoples?
questions.q_zh: 斯坦利公园在哪些原住民族的土地上？
questions.explain_en: Musqueam, Squamish and Tsleil-Waututh Nations.
questions.explain_zh: 马斯昆、斯阔米什和茨莱尔-沃图斯原住民。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Owls can turn their heads about…
questions.q_zh: 猫头鹰的头大约能转多少度？
questions.explain_en: Owls can't move their eyes, so they turn their heads.
questions.explain_zh: 猫头鹰的眼睛不能转，所以靠转头。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Bats find insects in the dark using…
questions.q_zh: 蝙蝠在黑暗中靠什么找到虫子？
questions.explain_en: They hear the echoes of their own calls.
questions.explain_zh: 它们听自己叫声的回声。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Why does the seawall path flood at very high tide?
questions.q_zh: 海堤小路在大潮时为什么会被淹？
questions.explain_en: The Moon's gravity causes tides.
questions.explain_zh: 月球的引力造成潮汐。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Fallen leaves on the forest floor break down because of…
questions.q_zh: 森林地上的落叶为什么会慢慢分解？
questions.explain_en: Fungi, worms and bacteria recycle them into soil.
questions.explain_zh: 真菌、蚯蚓和细菌把它们变成泥土。

questions.subject: stanley_park
questions.q_en: Siwash Rock (Slhx̱í7lsh in Squamish) stands next to the seawall. It is made of…
questions.q_zh: 海堤边的 Siwash Rock（斯阔米什语叫 Slhx̱í7lsh）是什么构成的？
questions.explain_en: It formed about 32 million years ago when magma cooled underground.
questions.explain_zh: 它是约 3200 万年前地下岩浆冷却形成的。

questions.subject: halloween
questions.q_en: A full moon happens about every…
questions.q_zh: 满月大约多久出现一次？
questions.explain_en: That's one lunar cycle.
questions.explain_zh: 这是一个月相周期。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Salmon swim from the ocean back up rivers to…
questions.q_zh: 三文鱼从大海游回河里是为了什么？
questions.explain_en: They return to the stream where they hatched.
questions.explain_zh: 它们回到自己出生的小溪产卵。

questions.subject: math_science
questions.q_en: The Stanley Park seawall loop is about 9 km. At 12 km/h, about how long is one loop?
questions.q_zh: 斯坦利公园海堤一圈约 9 公里，每小时骑 12 公里，骑一圈大约多久？
questions.explain_en: 9 ÷ 12 = 0.75 hour = 45 minutes.

questions.subject: halloween
questions.q_en: Halloween is on October 31. How many days until November 11?
questions.q_zh: 万圣节是 10 月 31 日，离 11 月 11 日还有几天？
questions.explain_en: 1 day to Nov 1, then 10 more.
questions.explain_zh: 到 11 月 1 日 1 天，再过 10 天。

questions.subject: stanley_park
questions.q_en: Which bridge goes from Stanley Park to the North Shore?
questions.q_zh: 哪座桥从斯坦利公园通往北岸？
questions.explain_en: Lions Gate Bridge opened in 1938. It links Stanley Park to the North Shore.
questions.explain_zh: 狮门大桥 1938 年通车，连接斯坦利公园和北岸。

questions.subject: stanley_park
questions.q_en: The Nine O'Clock Gun fires every night at…
questions.q_zh: Nine O'Clock Gun 每天晚上几点开炮？
questions.explain_en: It's been a Vancouver tradition for over 100 years.
questions.explain_zh: 这是温哥华一百多年的传统。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Raccoons are nocturnal. That means they are active…
questions.q_zh: 浣熊是夜行动物，意思是它们什么时候活动？
questions.explain_en: Nocturnal animals sleep in the day.
questions.explain_zh: 夜行动物白天睡觉。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Bats are…
questions.q_zh: 蝙蝠属于哪一类动物？
questions.explain_en: Bats have fur and feed milk to babies.
questions.explain_zh: 蝙蝠有毛，用奶喂宝宝。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Which tall bird with long legs nests in Stanley Park?
questions.q_zh: 哪种长腿高个子的鸟在斯坦利公园筑巢？
questions.explain_en: Herons build big nests high in the trees.
questions.explain_zh: 大蓝鹭在高高的树上搭大窝。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: B.C.'s official tree, found all over Stanley Park, is the…
questions.q_zh: 卑诗省的省树，斯坦利公园到处都有，是什么树？
questions.explain_en: The western red cedar is B.C.'s tree.
questions.explain_zh: 西部红雪松是卑诗省的省树。

questions.subject: halloween
questions.q_en: A pumpkin is mostly made of…
questions.q_zh: 南瓜里面大部分是什么？
questions.explain_en: A pumpkin is about 90% water.
questions.explain_zh: 南瓜大约 90% 是水。

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: CAPYBARA! Bara loves water. Would Bara like the seawall?
questions.q_zh: CAPYBARA！Bara 爱水，它会喜欢海堤吗？
questions.explain_en: Capybaras love water, though they prefer fresh water.
questions.explain_zh: 卡皮巴拉爱水，不过它们更喜欢淡水。

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: CAPYBARA! What costume suits a capybara best?
questions.q_zh: CAPYBARA！哪套万圣节服装最适合卡皮巴拉？
questions.explain_en: Bara can't skate, but a pumpkin hat looks great!
questions.explain_zh: Bara 不会溜冰，但戴南瓜帽超好看！

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: CAPYBARA! Capybaras and raccoons both come from…
questions.q_zh: CAPYBARA！卡皮巴拉和浣熊老家都在哪个大洲？
questions.explain_en: Capybaras are from South America; raccoons from North America.
questions.explain_zh: 卡皮巴拉来自南美洲，浣熊来自北美洲。
